tagline.en_US: A self-hosted start page for services, bookmarks, status checks and dashboards.

description.en_US: Dashy is a self-hosted personal dashboard and application launcher designed for organizing services, bookmarks, and homelab tools. It provides customizable layouts across multiple pages and views, including minimal startpage and multi-app workspace modes. The platform includes live status checks for services and hosts, dynamic data widgets, keyboard navigation, and instant search capabilities.
